name: AgendaForge
description:
AgendaForge is an AI-native event management CRM for conferences, summits, and meetups. This connector gives Claude secure access to your AgendaForge workspace so you can run event operations in plain language.

Read tools answer questions instantly from live data: list events, inspect the agenda, check schedule conflicts, track CFP submissions through your review pipeline, and look up speakers, contacts, sponsors, forms, registrations, and email activity. Keyword and semantic search work across all of it.

Write and communication tools are approval-gated by design. When Claude creates a session, updates a sponsor, imports contacts, or drafts an email, nothing changes until an organizer reviews and approves the proposal inside AgendaForge. You get the speed of an AI copilot with human sign-off on every change.

Typical workflows:
- "Which CFP submissions about AI are still unreviewed?" then "Accept the top two and draft speaker confirmations."
- "Find gaps in day two of the agenda and propose sessions to fill them."
- "How are registrations trending, and which ticket types are selling?"
- "Import these 20 contacts, tag them as press, and invite them to the portal."

Authentication is OAuth 2.1 via WorkOS AuthKit, or an organization API key with mcp:read and mcp:write scopes. Access is always scoped to the organizations you belong to, writes are idempotent, and every action is audit-logged.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AgendaForge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AgendaForge to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.agendaforge.app/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AgendaForge MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AgendaForge lists 53 MCP tools, including add_contact_note, assign_speaker, check_in_attendee, check_schedule_conflicts, create_email_template, create_event, create_form, create_session, create_session_from_submission, create_speaker_task, create_sponsor, and decide_submission.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AgendaForge?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AgendaForge in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
AgendaForge requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AgendaForge is developed by AgendaForge. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
